name: When is whole-home interior restoration required instead of spot repairs?

mainEntity.name: When is whole-home interior restoration required instead of spot repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: A whole-home restoration becomes necessary when structural integrity is compromised, widespread moisture affects multiple rooms, or a neglected property requires complete rehabilitation, such as after foreclosure. Visible indicators include widespread sagging ceilings, buckled subflooring, degraded drywall throughout, and compromised wall framing. Addressing these issues immediately protects the building envelope and prevents systemic damage from spreading into electrical channels and adjoining living areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Whole-home restoration is needed when damage affects structural framing across multiple areas, subflooring buckles, or long-term neglect requires full interior rehabilitation.
